results.description: Pixel art game resource for Tumble Toy, a cute handmade toy-block puzzle game. Pastel sky blue, cream, mint, peach, coral-pink and dark-plum palette; crisp hard pixels; simple readable shapes; charming toy-room style; no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no photorealism, no smooth antialiasing. A single blank six-sided toy die body in quarter view, cream top face, mint left face, peach right face, compact 1-pixel dark-plum outline, centered with a transparent margin. No pips or symbols; all three visible faces must stay blank for code-rendered values.
